title: Mistborn: The Final Empire
author: Brandon Sanderson
description: Epic fantasy with political rebellion, a detailed magic system, found family, and an oppressive empire.

title: The Will of the Many
author: James Islington
description: A young man infiltrates an elite academy inside a rigid hierarchical empire while hiding his true identity.

description: A fractured civilization faces repeated apocalypse in a story blending speculative science, oppression, survival, and powerful magic.

description: Dark academic fantasy about language, empire, colonialism, translation, and resistance.

description: A crew of criminals attempts an impossible heist in a dangerous fantasy city.

author: Scott Lynch
description: A group of gifted thieves runs elaborate confidence schemes in a violent fantasy city.

title: The Blade Itself

description: A government experiment triggers a catastrophic outbreak and a long struggle for human survival.

description: A wilderness trip becomes a terrifying survival story involving infection, isolation, and body horror.

description: An injured novelist is held captive by an obsessive fan in a tense psychological horror story.

title: Pet Sematary
author: Stephen King
description: A family discovers a burial ground with terrifying supernatural consequences.

title: The Silent Patient
author: Alex Michaelides
description: A psychotherapist becomes obsessed with discovering why a woman stopped speaking after being accused of murder.

title: Gone Girl
author: Gillian Flynn
description: A marriage becomes the center of a disappearance investigation filled with manipulation and unreliable narratives.

title: The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo
author: Taylor Jenkins Reid

title: Circe

title: Piranesi
